## PERIANAL/ANORECTAL ABSCESS
Antibiotics should typically be reserved for patients with an anorectal abscess
complicated by cellulitis, systemic signs of infection, underlying
immunosuppression, or failure to improve with drainage alone.
Cultures of abscess fluid are not routinely recommended. Consider in patients
who will be treated with adjunctive antibiotic treatment for systemic signs of
infection, recurrent infection or nonhealing wounds, or underlying
immunosuppression.
## Primary therapy: abscess drainage
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## Adjunctive antimicrobial treatment for patients with above complications.
## Duration of treatment
5 days of antibiotics after incision and drainage is recommended. In the absence
of source control, recommended duration is 7-14 days based on severity of
infection, underlying immunosuppression, and clinical response.
## Mild disease, outpatients, oral transition
Preferred:
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h [R]](psjzid-amoxicillin-clavulanate-875-125-mg-po-q12h)
Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)
[Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500](orz-set-abx-trimeth-sulfa-ds-q12h-metro-500mg-po-q12h)
mg PO q12h [DI]
< OR >
[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]](orz-set-abx-cipro-500mg-po-q12h-metro-500mg-po-q12h)
## Inpatient

treatment
Preferred:
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]](orz-set-abx-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h-metron-500mg-iv-q8h)
Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]](orz-set-abx-ciprof-400mg-iv-q12-metron-500mg-iv-q8h)
## Severe - critical illness
Preferred:
[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R]](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)
Alternative:
[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]](orz-set-abx-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h-metronidazole-500-mg-iv-q8h)
Alternative for severe beta-lactam reaction:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]
